title: Apple iPhone Duo review: A first-class foldable

evidence.quote: However, between John Ternus taking the reins as CEO and the arrival of the iPhone Duo ($1,999), it feels like Apple has embarked upon another paradigm shift that could pave the way for the company's next generation of hardware.
However, between John Ternus taking the reins as CEO and the arrival of the iPhone Duo ($1,999), it feels like Apple has embarked upon another paradigm shift...

claims.claim: Duo modelinin dış kısmında 1,878 x 2,670 çözünürlüğünde 5.4 inç OLED ekran bulunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: On the outside, the Duo features a glossy 1,878 x 2,670 5.4-inch OLED display with 120Hz ProMotion support and an impressive peak brightness of up to 3,000 nits.

claims.claim: Duo modelinin iç kısmında 1,398 x 2,034 çözünürlüğünde 7.6 inç ekran bulunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Meanwhile on the inside, there's a larger 1,398 x 2,034 7.6-inch panel with a matching 1:1.4 aspect ratio and lofty luminance.

claims.claim: Duo modelinin nanotexture ekran katmanının değiştirilmesi 49 dolar ücret gerektirmektedir.

evidence.quote: A word of caution: While it is replaceable (for a $49 fee), the Duo's nanotexture layer can be removed if you pick at it too much.

The main drawback to the Duo's beefy build is that it weighs 254 grams (8.96 ounces), which is more than 25 percent heavier than a Galaxy Z Fold 8, despite the latter having the same number of cameras and larger displays.
The main drawback to the Duo's beefy build is that it weighs 254 grams (8.96 ounces)...

claims.claim: Duo, iPhone 18 Pro ile aynı olan A20 Pro çipinden güç almaktadır.

evidence.quote: Powered by an A20 Pro chip, the same as what you get in an iPhone 18 Pro, the Duo has no shortage of processing power.

claims.claim: Duo modelinin arka kamerasında iki adet 48 megapiksel sensör bulunmaktadır.
Yapılan yerel video testinde Duo 28 saat 48 dakika dayanmıştır.
